title: MCP credentials
subtitle: Let AI clients (Cursor, n8n, Claude) read the company's data through the Model Context Protocol.
error: The action could not be completed.

server.title: MCP server URL
server.auth: Authentication: send the token in the header
server.tips: Best practices: use one credential per client and revoke the ones not in use. Tools are read-only.

empty.title: No MCP credentials
empty.body: Create a credential to connect an MCP client.

authTypeHint.static: Generates a token for clients such as Cursor and n8n. It is shown only once.
authTypeHint.oauth: For connectors that sign in, such as Claude. There is no token to copy.

connector.title: OAuth connector created
connector.step1: In Claude, open Settings > Connectors and choose Add custom connector.
connector.step2: Name the connector and paste the URL above.
connector.step3: Click Connect, sign in to {app} and authorize access to the company.
connector.step4: Come back and reload this page: the status changes to "Connected · <client>".

created.title: Credential created
created.warning: Copy it now: the token will not be shown again.

revoke.title: Revoke credential?
revoke.body: The credential "{name}" stops working immediately and the clients using it lose access.
